item.title: Gov. Mikie Sherrill Endorses DiVincenzo for 7th Term as Essex Exec
item.description: "It's easy to do when you have County Executive Joe DiVincenzo showing everybody what true public service looks like," said Sherrill. "Showing everybody what it takes to have a world class zoo. A world class vaccine site. Lead line replacements across the county. Just getting the basic rights so we can do the big things."
